answer.rationale: Memory 57 most directly supports sustainable qualified revenue because it reports qualified revenue and no measurable retention harm, though incentive economics and measurement duration are omitted. Memory 44 provides strong evidence through better enterprise conversion and pipeline quality, but does not establish closed revenue, sales costs, or durability. Memory 73 reports acquisition and revenue lift in the currently threatened segment, but omits margins, customer quality, retention, and post-promotion durability. Memory 31 documents a durable activation lift, but activation remains only a proxy for qualified revenue. Memories 86 and 91 report improvements in early adoption behaviors without evidence of downstream retention or revenue; memory 91 is weakest because its outcomes are limited to week-one engagement and a first action, with no stated durability.
